limitations: Only matched completed rounds are used; repeated rounds do not increase a question weight. Missing rounds are preserved and not imputed.
All94 includes86 questions with3 rounds,6 with2 and2 with1. Complete86 checks use the same questions and3 rounds.
Historical and later rounds have protocol/date differences; observed paired estimates do not isolate every source of variation.
Question-equal maximum depth and node count measure average task-level structure. Node-weighted depth answers an event-pool question and is retained as a secondary description.
Root-only trees have zero depth and one node; conditional branching averages are undefined for them, so no zero-valued branching proxy is inserted into the all-question mean.
